verses.text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee. He went to the area of Judea on the other side of the Jordan River.
Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, "Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for any reason at all?"
Jesus replied, "Have you not read that in the beginning the Creator made them male and female?
He said, 'That is why a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one.'
So they are no longer two, but one. What God has joined together, no one should separate."
They asked him, "Then why did Moses command that a man can give his wife a written notice of divorce and send her away?"
Jesus replied, "Moses allowed you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not like this from the beginning.
I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, unless his wife has been unfaithful. And anyone who marries a divorced woman commits adultery."
The followers said to him, "If this is how it is between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry."
Jesus replied, "Not everyone can accept this teaching. Only those whom God helps can accept it.

Some people cannot marry because they were born that way. Others were made that way by other people. And others choose not to marry for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. Whoever can accept this teaching should accept it."
Then people brought little children to Jesus so that he could put his hands on them and pray for them. But the followers told them off.
Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not stop them. The kingdom of heaven belongs to people like them."
He put his hands on them, and then he went on from there.
Just then a man came up to Jesus and asked, "Good teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?"
Jesus replied, "Why do you call me good? No one is good except one, and that is God. If you want to enter life, obey the commandments."
"Which ones?" the man asked. Jesus replied, "'Do not murder. Do not commit adultery. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.
Honour your father and mother.' And, 'Love your neighbour as you love yourself.'"
"I have obeyed all these since I was young," the young man said. "What do I still need to do?"
Jesus answered, "If you want to be perfect, go and sell everything you own and give the money to poor people. Then you will have treasure in heaven. Then come and follow me."
When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
Then Jesus said to his followers, "I tell you for certain, it is hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.
Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."
When the followers heard this, they were completely amazed. They asked, "Then who can be saved?"
Jesus looked at them and said, "For people this is impossible. But for God everything is possible."
Then Peter said to him, "We have left everything to follow you! What will we get?"

Jesus said to them, "I tell you for certain, when everything is made new, the Son of Man will sit on his glorious throne. Then you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
And everyone who has left houses, brothers, sisters, father, mother, wife, children or fields for me will receive a hundred times as much, and they will receive eternal life.
But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first."
